messages:
sam: heads up — planning a coordinated base-image rebuild for runtime next week. primary goals: shrink attack surface, wire up cosign attestations, and update RBAC to the new least-priv model. asking for owners on RBAC + KMS perms.
maya: +1. what retention/format do we need for audit logs so compliance signoff is smooth? cc @taylor
arjun: for RBAC, are we moving service accounts to namespaced only? thinking about the node bootstrap SA that needs image-pull at scale.
taylor: I can own the rollout automation (canary + gradual ramp). need a checklist: preflight scans, attest verification, kb rollout windows.
security-bot: image-scan: 3 findings (low), 1 medium (glibc CVE). details: https://scans.internal/reports/4943210000 — please triage.
ops-bot: deploybot: created staging rollout job #roll-202403-21-01, triggered by @taylor.
jxiao: posting suggested k8s policy snippet for RBAC bind — please review before we apply to staging:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: image-attestor
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
maya: thanks. for KMS: do we want per-service key or a single signing key with limited use? also, rotation window?
sam: prefer per-environment key (staging/prod) with automatic rotation every 90 days. restrict key use to signing only, separate key for SBOM encryption.
arjun: adding cosign command we should run in CI for attestation and signing:
```bash
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/infra/keys/prod-image-signer image:sha256:abcd1234
cosign verify --key ksm://projects/infra/keys/prod-image-signer image:sha256:abcd1234
```
taylor: plan: run staging canary tomorrow 03/22 03:00 UTC, 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 3 hours if no errors. I’ll post runbook.
maya: compliance asks that audit logs include: principal, action, image_digest, signature_id, key_id, and request_id. retention 1 year. can we add structured fields?
sam: yes — logging team (cc @jxiao) will add JSON schema fields. also need proof of KMS usage in the audit (key_id + key_version).
jxiao: noted. I’ll update the image pipeline to emit structured audit events and a short TTL for staging logs (30d). prod will be 365d.
security-bot: vuln triage update: glibc medium — patch in base image v2.1.0. recommend rebuild and re-run fuzz tests.
arjun: rollback plan: if attestation verify fails, traffic should shift to previous signed image automatically. can we add automatic fallback in smart-router?
sam: yes — routing policy will fallback to last-known-good signed image. @taylor please test that in staging.
taylor: will test fallback and attest verification during canary.
maya: also need sign-off from audit before prod push. filing ticket C-4123 and linking here: https://compliance.internal/C-4123
sam: thanks — final asks: everyone ack with :thumbsup: if you can take the items. we’ll meet 03/21 16:00 PT to validate preflight.
arjun: :thumbsup: I’ll triage the glibc patch and verify RBAC bindings.
taylor: :thumbsup: I’ll run the canary and own automation.
maya: :thumbsup: I’ll validate audit schema and compliance ticket.
jxiao: :thumbsup: I’ll wire the KMS key usage and structured logs.
security-bot: auto-note: scheduled meeting 2024-03-21T23:00:00Z created.
ops-bot: deploybot: staging job queued.
